name: CachedSearch: best-of-N seeds on cached drafts
plain: Uses a step cache to make seed search cheap instead of to make the final render fast. Every candidate seed is sampled with core EasyCache, decoded and scored by an image-reward model, then the winning seed is sampled again with the cache off. Sampling is seeded, so the delivered latent is a plain full-compute render of that seed.
math:
For s in seed..seed+N−1: draft_s = sample(EasyCache(model), s); score_s = mean ImageReward(prompt, frames) over up to 8 evenly spaced frames.
winner = argmax score. commit on: return sample(model, winner). commit off: return draft_winner.

props.hook: core EasyCache wrappers on a clone, inside a sampler node
props.architectures: Whatever core EasyCache and common_ksampler support; decodes every draft with the VAE
